searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/358 - add consensus block value to v3 - this is needed for multiplexing VC:s to fairly choose a block (ie the execution block value is mostly useless without it) genesis is (implicitly) a finalized state so it should consistently be returned by everybody, not sure why there's confusion here? Some clients don't return `/finalized` pre-genesis (assuming before theres a non genesis finalized) which is why i was asking if everyone could make sure. ok - I guess we can link to https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#fork-choice which points this out, ie that the finalized checkpoint at genesis is the genesis state/block it'll just make checkpointz a lot cleaner if its implemented consistently imo <@602753420033785856> <@884836500037066862><@144468805697929216> <@308223150725005322> <@688748669268132001> <@792822129019584562> <@993802539856314398> #358 is going to need a look, if its accepted we may want to merge it soonish because it changes what the response for v3 block is with new required data and header. I'll be away for a week so if another contrib can merge it if theres agreement please, otherwise i'll deal with it when i get back. sorry for the group slap but imo fairly important Really anyone looking at deneb and block v3, but these are from the first blockv3 pr...

excerpts.content: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/358 - add consensus block value to v3 - this is needed for multiplexing VC:s to fairly choose a block (ie the execution block value is mostly useless without it)

excerpts.author: arnetheduck
excerpts.content: genesis is (implicitly) a finalized state so it should consistently be returned by everybody, not sure why there's confusion here?

excerpts.author: .paulharris
excerpts.content: Some clients don't return `/finalized` pre-genesis (assuming before theres a non genesis finalized) which is why i was asking if everyone could make sure.

excerpts.author: arnetheduck
excerpts.content: ok - I guess we can link to https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#fork-choice which points this out, ie that the finalized checkpoint at genesis is the genesis state/block
